entity: Medical Entomologist of the South Carolina State Board of Health and Environmental Control
role: State health official consulted on insect problems
stance_basis: referenced as a consultative authority the Applicant would follow, with no independent position stated
summary: The Medical Entomologist of the South Carolina State Board of Health and Environmental Control is mentioned solely as a consultative resource that the Applicant would turn to if mosquito or insect problems arose during project operation. No independent position or complaint is attributed to this official; they are referenced only as a regulatory/advisory authority whose recommendations the Applicant commits to following. The document notes that mosquito problems are not expected to occur due to steep shorelines and large water level fluctuations.
summary_quote: The Applicant has the capability to control mosquito breeding in the project area, should such a problem occur, and would consult with and follow the recommendations of the Medical Entomologist of the South Carolina State Board of Health and Environmental Control on any insect problem.
